title: An expert’s opinion: Interview with Theresa Seipp on new challenges in media and information literacy
content:
Ahead of the Global Media and Information Literacy Week, running from 24 to 31 October 2026, Luca Arfini from European Science - Media Hub from the European Parliament spoke with Dr Theresa Josephine Seipp.

The post An expert’s opinion: Interview with Theresa Seipp on new challenges in media and information literacy appeared first on IVIR.
